items.title: Grid → maze (GPU grid first)
items.result: Neutral on the corpus (21/42, 83 unrouted, 117 violations), a win on dense boards; 3.3× the time.

items.title: Grid → maze, first version
items.result: Lost 609 connections to timeouts (19/42 clean); fixed by cached obstacle maps and a 40% time share.

items.title: Region history
items.result: Mixed, promising: ×0.1 cuts violations to 107 at no cost; ×0.25 reaches 73 unrouted but loses a clean board.

items.title: Obstacle-aware heuristic (E1)
items.result: Neutral and 2.2× slower: 87 unrouted, 119 violations, fewest vias. Opt-in.

items.title: Ripup history
items.result: Negative: per-net history detours with more vias and violations (80–88 unrouted, 144–189 violations). Off.

items.title: Baseline
items.result: 42 KiCad-refereed PCBench boards. Freerouting 15/42 clean, CopperRoute 23/42 (81 unrouted, 122 violations); governed matches main.
